findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: akulacyber_search_products, akulacyber_get_product, akulacyber_create_cart_link, akulacyber_get_store_policy · Private data: akulacyber_get_store_policy · Public sink: akulacyber_get_store_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: akulacyber_search_products, akulacyber_get_product, akulacyber_create_cart_link, akulacyber_get_store_policy · Private data: akulacyber_get_store_policy · Public sink: akulacyber_get_store_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
